text: Implemented the production AlderDataBoundary under the predictive package. It performs typed row restriction, measurement composition, explicit budgeted local materialization, and Alder InMemoryData construction; AlderRowLedger restores authoritative SampleIds from emitted RowIds and rejects duplicate, missing, or foreign ordinals. Added local-axis FeatureView/Schema values and a four-stage receipt that reports row mapping, measurement composition, matrix cells, row/example allocations, and per-read/write coordinate-copy behavior. Alder DataFingerprint is a scientific summary independent of backend/materialization. Focused JVM/JS suites pass 4/4, the Alder boundary court and diff checks pass.
